description: Source code for UDP throughput testing and uploading in Zephyr OS, including functions for packet creation, sending, receiving, and asynchronous operation handling.

methods.name: zperf_upload_decode_stat
methods.description: Decodes UDP performance statistics from received data into results structure.

methods.name: zperf_upload_fin
methods.description: Finalizes the upload by sending a datagram and receiving statistics.

methods.name: udp_upload
methods.description: Performs UDP upload for specified duration, packet size, and rate, collecting results.

methods.name: zperf_udp_upload
methods.description: Sets up socket and initiates UDP upload process.

methods.name: udp_upload_async_work
methods.description: Worker function for asynchronous UDP upload, invoking callback on start, finish, or error.

methods.name: zperf_udp_upload_async
methods.description: Starts asynchronous UDP upload with callback and user data.

methods.name: zperf_udp_uploader_init
methods.description: Initializes the UDP uploader, setting up work structure.
